header: Week of Monday 21 September 2026 — built 2026-09-21 from 93 daily snapshots (2026-06-17 to 2026-09-21), 2,878 pieces with a price record across 194 labels.
275 pieces changed price and 273 of those moves are confirmed by a later snapshot; the biggest is 50% at Addy Knits.
259 pieces are down to one or two in-stock sizes from a run of four or more, and 778 were listed by their own shop in the last 7 days.
